decision: Do not promote. Narrowing responsibility and source-ID selection improved schema reliability and eliminated correction research, but five of six cases still fail an intended semantic or account-selection condition. No production changes.

score_scope.note: Counts concern six selected regressions, not accuracy estimates; semantic categories can overlap. No source retrieval, reranking, final response, save or browser acceptance was tested.

measurement.cost_note: Ledger rounds per call. Prior zero-dispatch harness reservation $0.425431 remains conservatively charged and is not represented as measured provider spend. Separate earlier embedding uncertainty $1.09 also remains reserved. Initial auto-review rejection dispatched nothing.

cases.name: original_aster_held_drive
cases.requested_legal_coverage: Both independent deposit and drive investigations retained. Client-question drafting correctly excluded from research-only output.
cases.improvement: The previously held drive range a15 is selectable and selected; no exact-quote fabrication or extra client-question search work.

consequential_errors.output: retention of client's original design drive by equipment owner
consequential_errors.source: the owner's technician still has our client's original design drive; the owner now says it can retain the drive
consequential_errors.finding: Neutral issue title collapses the reported custodian (technician) and the party asserting retention entitlement (owner). This can change the relationship presented to retrieval.

cases.source_selection: Both work items select full mixed message a2 plus overlapping spans; a20 is a restriction rather than factual narrative. First item includes the entire unrelated drive request and client-question instructions via a2.
cases.concept_quality: Deposit concepts remain broad conversational topics rather than sharply distinct vocabulary; tenant terminology may steer movable-equipment hire toward immovable tenancy. Lien, temporary purpose and return remedies add potentially distinct investigation concepts, but no applicable lien is established.
cases.not_counted_as_error: Conditional enquiry into lien/loan/license concepts is allowed; it is not an assertion that an entitlement exists. No new missing-report nonexistence assertion observed here.

cases.name: not_supplied_is_not_nonexistent
cases.requested_legal_coverage: Deposit and drive work both preserved; client-question drafting correctly not emitted as a separate investigation.

consequential_errors.output: damage claims without joint inspection report / damage claims absent inspection report
consequential_errors.source: no joint inspection report has been supplied
consequential_errors.finding: Turns absence from the supplied record into absence of the report.

consequential_errors.source: leased a laser cutter and returned it on 3 September
consequential_errors.finding: Adds termination, which returning the cutter does not itself establish.

cases.source_selection: Selects full mixed a2 plus overlapping a4; a5 is the request to research/draft and a6 is a restriction. Both work items therefore search task wording and the other dispute.
cases.concept_quality: Limited-purpose return is useful distinct vocabulary. Deposit queries overlap heavily. Calling the separate client design drive equipment accessories/digital property risks expanding or changing the identified object; the source gives possession of a drive, not a data-only dispute.
cases.not_counted_as_error: No assertion of a proved lien or an admission was required for failure; the report and termination errors independently fail the frozen oracle.

cases.name: actor_agency_and_explicit_alternative
cases.requested_legal_coverage: Actual and expressly authorised hypothetical investigations are separately represented; no actual record change/contact claimed.

consequential_errors.output: effect of absence of written or emailed modification / lack of documentary evidence
consequential_errors.source: written service agreement not examined; no email recording extension forwarded
consequential_errors.finding: Actual-account enquiry does not preserve unavailable versus absent documentary material.

consequential_errors.output: assuming express agency authorization ... without written confirmation / extension not recorded in writing or email
consequential_errors.source: assume ... no email recording the extension was ever created
consequential_errors.finding: Authorised no-email hypothetical is broadened to no written confirmation of any kind.

cases.source_selection: Actual work selects full prior a2 plus duplicated task a3; alternative selects full latest a5 plus duplicated task a6. Hypothetical framing is correctly retained and is not treated as selection noise.
cases.concept_quality: Agency authority and reliance are useful distinct concepts. The third hypothetical phrase, separation of assumptions from client denial, is an analysis instruction instead of a legal concept likely to improve corpus discovery.
cases.not_counted_as_error: Reviewing actual account for a comparison is allowed. Investigating authority under the explicit alternative is legitimate even though the actual client denies authority.

cases.name: mixed_independent_requests_followup
cases.requested_legal_coverage: Both interim-relief explanation and resumed passage-use investigation preserved. Ownership remains unsettled; independent-access-right denial and no court determination remain in selected original account.
cases.source_selection: Interim-relief investigation selects a4 (entire latest task message) and a3 (request to explain), neither a focused factual account; a general legal explanation could select no account. Passage work selects a4/a6 task directions along with useful prior a1/a2 and current missing-plan a8. Direct account search would include the task itself and duplicate words.
cases.concept_quality: Permission/license, independent easement/prescriptive right and unresolved ownership are distinct, useful investigation topics. Interim-relief concepts are broad but responsive; they are hypotheses, not assertions that a right is established.
cases.not_counted_as_error: No notice was drafted, no source said ownership was proved, and no independent legal request was dropped. This is the strongest substantive research case; failure is selected-account scope, not an invented factual finding.

cases.name: correction_no_send_no_law
cases.requested_legal_coverage: work=[] correctly leaves summary repair and no-send restriction to interpreter/record/writer owners.
cases.source_selection: No unnecessary account search or concept search.
cases.limit: Does not prove actual correction, persistent no-send handling or useful reply; those stages were not exercised.

cases.name: greeting_social_close
cases.requested_legal_coverage: False research work created despite explicit close for today.

consequential_errors.output: Legal investigation on rent review and tenancy papers requirements
consequential_errors.source: Thanks, this is enough for today. Good night. Earlier: When I return with tenancy papers, we can look at the rent demand.
consequential_errors.finding: Restarts earlier conditional pending work without current request; adds paperwork-rights and rent-adjustment enquiries not requested by the close.

cases.source_selection: Selects only earlier a1 and ignores latest close as a control on current research. Trigger_source_id would mechanically link latest turn but cannot prove research is authorised.
cases.concept_quality: Search topics do not cure the absent current research need.
cases.not_counted_as_error: Earlier account is valid original text; failure is current-work interpretation, not unowned source identity.

general_findings: Short ID selection removes copied-quote failures, but an exact owned source is not necessarily the relevant account; model still chooses whole mixed messages and instructions. Code must not infer semantic account purpose from IDs.
Removing general work planning helps role focus, shown by the correction control; latest-message current-work interpretation remains necessary because social closure still restarts earlier work.

Concept purposes still paraphrase factual premises, reintroducing nonexistent-report, ended-lease and absent-writing assertions despite an exact underlying account. Redundant generated factual premises remain a measured problem.

Two-three concepts per independent dispute preserves coverage but does not ensure concise formal vocabulary or distinct discovery contribution. Only a held-corpus comparison can establish relevance/recall improvement.
next_review_only: Before another experiment, decide the narrow responsibility boundary for current research need and whether concepts need any factual-purpose paraphrase. Preserve the existing failed cases and positive correction/interim/passage distinctions. No new prompt/model call is authorised by this assessment.
